request.query: In a linear ordered field x < y + 1 and 6 <= y imply 2*x^2 < 3*y^2

items.name: mul_le_of_forall_lt_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {a b c : α},
  0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ c → (∀ a' ≥ 0, a' < a → ∀ b' ≥ 0, b' < b → a' * b' ≤ c) → a * b ≤ c

items.name: Order.le_of_lt_add_one
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x y : α} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : Add α] [inst_2 : One α] [SuccAddOrder α], x < y + 1 → x ≤ y

items.name: sq_lt_sq'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Ring α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {a b : α},
  -b < a → a < b → a ^ 2 < b ^ 2

items.name: LinearOrderedSemiField.toDenselyOrdered
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  DenselyOrdered α

items.name: mul_self_le_mul_self_of_le_of_neg_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] {a b : R} [MulPosMono R] [PosMulMono R] [AddLeftMono R],
  a ≤ b → -a ≤ b → a * a ≤ b * b
